review: Zwei Faust shines in a Zwei Team where she can offer buffs and recieve them. On her own, she's not worth using. She can work on a sole Zwei ID team but she will leave much to be expected. Zwei Teams as of now are in an exceptionally bad state, where only 2 out of 4 IDs are actually good. Notable E.G.O Synergies: Fluid Sac - Fuels Fluid Sac completely. Pairing it with her defensive buffs, it makes the team way more durable than it would be normally.
